build_feedforward_layer: build a feedforward neural network layer with configurable hidden dimension and activation function
build_feedforward_with_multiplier: build a feedforward layer using a hidden layer multiplier to expand intermediate dimensions
build_feedforward_with_dropout: build a feedforward layer with dropout regularization for training robustness
build_feedforward_custom_io: build a feedforward layer with custom input and output dimensions instead of hidden_dim
build_feedforward_linear_only: build a feedforward layer with zero hidden layer multiplier for a single linear transformation
